items.title: What if Northwind had rolled out tokens and components faster (or slower)?
items.description: Northwind's real rollout took about a year to reach 95% token/component adoption across its 40 screens, with visual-inconsistency incidents (like the checkout disabled-state bug) falling from 14/month to about 2/month along the way. Drag the slider to see how many incidents per month you'd expect at a given adoption level, based on that same rate of improvement — the dashed line marks where Northwind actually started, at 10% adoption and 14 incidents.
items.compute: const baseline = 14; const floor = 1.5; const incidents = Math.max(floor, Math.round((baseline - (baseline - floor) * (params.adoptionPercent / 100)) * 10) / 10); return { incidents };
